title: Text Input
description: Text Input is a simple input field.

demos.label: Text input
demos.html: <input type="text" placeholder="Type here" class="input" />

demos.label: Text input with text label inside
Ghost style
demos.html: <input type="text" placeholder="Type here" class="input input-ghost" />

demos.label: With fieldset and fieldset-legend
demos.html:
What is your name?

Optional

demos.label: With fieldset and label
demos.html:
<fieldset class="fieldset">
  <label class="label" for="name">Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="input" placeholder="Name" />
</fieldset>

demos.label: Search input with icon
demos.html:
<label class="input">
  <svg class="h-[1em] opacity-50" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
    <g
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-width="2.5"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
    >
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
      <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <input type="search" required placeholder="Search" />
</label>
